steps.text: Drop of andariel in Hell, seed 0xc0ffee (illustrative input).
calc: Source: andariel; difficulty Hell; PlayerCount 1, party 1 (killer alone); magic find 200; expansion game.
Seed 0xc0ffee is an illustrative input: src.seed = {00c0ffee:0000029a}; the game would derive it (rng/seeds).

monster level 75 = MonStats Level column of the difficulty (tc.md B1: ilvl = the monster's stat 12); the game takes Levels.MonLvl*Ex for non-boss monsters in expansion Nightmare/Hell: not modelled here
quest TC (TreasureClass4, tc.md B6) needs the killer's quest state: not modelled here

steps.text: Base TC: 'Andariel (H)'.
calc: tc.md B: MonStats TreasureClass1 of the difficulty (tc.md B5) -> TC 832 'Andariel (H)'.
tc.md B1: ilvl = the monster's level (stat 12) = 75.

steps.text: Resolving TC 'Andariel (H)'.
calc: tc.md C1: the level upgrade gate is closed (expansion, difficulty > 0, monster source, not noRatio, not boss): lvl = 0.
tc.md C2: GetByIndex(832 'Andariel (H)', lvl 0): while lvl >= the next TC's level in the same group, move to the next TC (the base TC is kept even above lvl).

steps.text: The resolver starts at 'Andariel (H)': 7 picks, NoDrop 19, expansion total 49.
calc: tc.md D1: frame 0 = {TC, picksLeft = max(1, |Picks|), the TC's ratio words}; max = 6 for a monster drop (max 0 becomes 6).
'Andariel (H)': Picks 7 (a negative Picks takes every entry in order with no draw, tc.md D3), NoDrop 19, 5 entries, total 49 (tc.md A).
All draws below are on the source unit's seed {00c0ffee:0000029a}, one Step per draw (tc.md D4).

calc: tc.md F2: n = party + (PlayerCount - party) / 2 = 1; n <= 1: NoDrop stays 19.

Entry 0: gold, Prob 11, cumExp 0 (tc.md E1).

steps.text: Item creation for 'gold' (quality 2, normal): item seed {d3de83b9:0000029a}.
calc: uniques-sets.md A1-A2: DropCreateItem draws two Steps on the game seed (unit seed, then item.start); item.seed = {start, 666} = {d3de83b9, 666}. The game seed here is derived from the illustrative input.
tc.md H7: creation does not touch src.seed (seed stays {a28ed4c0:00507fab}).

steps.text: The normal builder for 'gold': success.
calc: affixes.md H: the normal builder runs on item seed {d3de83b9:0000029a}.
affixes.md H1: for a base other than a charm, body part, scroll or book the normal builder draws nothing of its own on the item seed (a charm takes the forced-affix pair, an inferred path).
Result: success.
ItemApplyProps draws (property values) are applied to the seed by our property model; the values are not shown.

steps.text: Item complete: gold.
calc: Result of the model: quality 2 (normal).
Name card: coloured by quality, no icon (schematic mode).

Not modelled here: gold amount and gold find (tc.md H8-H9), ItemInitStats values, the ethereal and socket rolls, the automagic pick after them (affixes.md J), the durability fix of a failed unique or set, property values.
